verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I'm casting my cares aside
I'm leaving my past behind

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: I'm setting my heart and mind on You, Jesus

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
I'm reaching my hands to Yours
Believing there's so much more

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines: Knowing that all You have in store for me is good, is good

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Today is the day, you have made
I will rejoice and be glad in it

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Today is the day, you have made
I will rejoice and be glad in it

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
I won't worry about tomorrow
I'm trusting in what you say, today is the day

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
I'm putting my fears aside
I'm leaving my doubts behind

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: I'm giving my hopes and dreams to you, Jesus

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
I'm reaching my hands to Yours
Believing there's so much more

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines: Knowing that all You have in store for me is good, is good

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Guys: I will stand upon your truth
(Girls echo)

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Guys: All my days I'll live for you
(Girls echo)

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
Guys: And I will stand upon your truth
(Girls echo)

verse.name: b1d
verse.lines:
Guys: All my days I'll live for you
(Girl: All my days I'll live)

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
Today is the day, you have made
I will rejoice and be glad in it

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
Today is the day, you have made
I will rejoice and be glad in it

verse.name: c2c
verse.lines:
I won't worry about tomorrow
Giving you my fears and sorrows

verse.name: c2d
verse.lines:
Where you lead me I will follow
I'm trusting in what you say, today is the day
